dct_description_sm: PSS' Millstream water quality monitoring aims to build community partnerships, and develop and implement sampling protocols for long term, community-based monitoring of the Millstream watershed. Sampling is conducted monthly by volunteers from the Friends of Millstream Watershed, a group of local residents that care about preserving the ecological integrity of the creek and restoring its salmonid populations.
dct_title_s: Peninsula Streams Society Water Quality Monitoring - Millstream
